screen.title: Wi-Fi QR code
screen.scan: Scan with your phone's camera to join

app.name: Wi-Fi QR Code
app.summary: A tile that shows a full-screen QR code your guests scan to join your Wi-Fi.
app.tile_example: Tap to show the code for Guest Wi-Fi
app.ssid_hint: The name of the Wi-Fi network (SSID), as phones list it.
app.password_hint: Leave it empty for an open network. It is kept in the screen's layout, like every option.
app.security_hint: WPA covers WPA, WPA2 and WPA3.
app.hidden_hint: On when the network does not broadcast its name.
app.show_password_hint: Write the password under the code, for a laptop or a phone without a camera.
app.top_line_hint: Small words above the name. Empty: Wi-Fi QR code.
app.middle_line_hint: The large words in the middle. Empty: the network name.
app.bottom_line_hint: Small words under the name. Empty: Tap for the code.
